vic: Quick flag for close - discovered a mis-applied promo credit that reduced recognized revenue this period. Credit memos applied to account CUST-992 instead of refunding an overpayment.

kelly: Can you paste the credit memo id?

vic: CM-55902 applied 2026-12-01. Amount $14,500. Applied_to=AR-23345 (should have been applied_to=AP-23345 refund flow). Looks like intake script matched on customer name variant.

ops-bot: Created ticket FIN-6621 for misapplied credit memo CM-55902.

kelly: Scope check: run `select cm.id,cm.amount,cm.applied_to from credit_memos cm where cm.created_at >= '2026-12-01' and cm.amount > 10000` to find similar issues.

vic: Ran it - only CM-55902 and CM-55910 (CM-55910 is fine).

kelly: Action: reverse the CM application: create JE to restore revenue (DR 2100 DeferredRevenue 14500 / CR 4000 AR 14500) dated 12/01, then post refund liability: DR 4000 AR 14500 / CR 2300 RefundLiability 14500. Then process refund to clear refund liability.

vic: I'll prepare JEs and coordinate with treasury for refund payout. Also updating intake mapping to prefer match on customer_id not name.

acct-bot: FIN-6621 updated: status=in_progress assignee=vic.
\nkelly: Please post JEs in Dec close with memo referencing FIN-6621. Also add a month-close QA step to sample applied credit memos >10k.

vic: Will do. Notifying treasury. Closing once refund clears.
